source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of structural disorders and brain tumours (PDF 50-51).

blocks.text: Structural bimariyan nervous system ki jismani banawat ki kharabi ya nuqsan se hoti hain; misalein brain tumour aur spinal cord ki choten hain.

blocks.caption: Brain tumour: dimagh mein cells ka ghair maamooli barhao ya dhela
rows: benign (ghair cancer) ya malignant (cancer); glial cells ya khud neurons se ban sakta hai
asal wajah maloom nahi; khatre ke asbab mein radiation, khandani tareekh aur kuch jeeni tabdeeliyan (mutations)
jagah par munhasir: sar dard, shadeed asabi dard, falij, dauray, behoshi

blocks.prompt: Brain tumour ki alamaat mareez se mareez kyun mukhtalif hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh tumour ki jagah par munhasir hain, kyunke dimagh ke mukhtalif hisse mukhtalif kaam qaboo karte hain.

items: Structural bimariyan: tumours, spinal cord ki choten. Brain tumour: benign ya malignant, glia ya neurons se; ilaj surgery, radiation, chemotherapy.
